description: Produzione percentuale lorda di energia elettrica da fonti rinnovabili (incluso idro) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. The indicator describes the production in gross percentage of electricity produced from renewable sources (excluding hydro). A summary table with the production by Region is displayed. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Gross percentage production of electricity from renewable sources (including hydro)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Utilizzo del territorio, n.d., Unità statistiche. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
